proposal.name: Stage application files selected by Git

plan.name: Stage application files selected by Git
plan.summary: Stage existing Python applications from Git's tracked and nonignored untracked file list when their root is inside a work tree, omitting deleted tracked files, preserving staging exclusions and regular-file checks, refusing submodules and ignored declared inputs, existing files, environment scripts or verification projects with named errors, and retaining the directory walk outside Git. Record the selection method in snapshot provenance and receipts, and keep dependency selection, tests, conformance, proofs and exploration one size larger on that same staged snapshot. The audit also found work-tree walks in copyTree and StagePackage's directory selections, so apply the same Git selection there within their existing copy boundaries and exclusions and align HashExisting with the files staged; leave verify.go's stage unchanged because it only gathers TLA+ modules rather than copying a work tree. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe these selection and refusal rules and receipt evidence, citing the existing staging and provenance decisions D-0054, D-0180, D-0181 and D-0199 and documentation rule D-0122. This changes the whole-tree policy and needs a new decision recorded by the merger, with its dependents checked and the final SPEC citations updated; the plumbing build must not write decisions/.

tests.name: TestGitStageUncommittedApplication
tests.says: A nested application stages tracked working bytes and nonignored untracked files, including an uncommitted project and unusual filenames, but not ignored payloads, deleted tracked files, excluded directories or files outside the application.

tests.name: TestGitStageMatchesFreshClone
tests.says: A committed application's staged paths and hashes are identical in its work tree and a fresh local clone despite ignored local payloads.

tests.name: TestGitStageRefusesIgnoredDeclarations
tests.says: Ignored invocation inputs, existing sources, environment scripts and verification projects are refused with their names before image selection.

tests.name: TestGitStageRefusesSubmodules
tests.says: Initialized and uninitialized submodules under the application are refused by name.

tests.name: TestGitStageLinkedWorktreeAndRegularFiles
tests.says: A linked work tree uses Git selection and never copies its .git file; selected symlinks are refused, including a symlink replacing a tracked parent directory.

tests.name: TestGitStageDirectoryFallback
tests.says: Outside Git the application keeps ordinary files even if .gitignore would ignore them, retains exclusions and nonregular-file refusal, and reports directory selection.

tests.name: TestGitStageSharedCopiers
tests.says: copyTree and StagePackage filter work-tree directory copies using Git without broadening their copy boundaries, HashExisting covers the selected bytes, ignored explicit existing files are refused, and non-Git copies keep their current behavior.

tests.name: TestGitStageSessionConsumers
tests.says: Image preparation, ordinary executions and exploration one size larger see the same filtered snapshot and selection provenance, unaffected by later original edits.

tests.name: TestGitStageReceiptSelection
tests.says: JSON preserves the snapshot's selection method and Markdown explains Git listing or whole-directory selection for ordinary and larger application executions.
